children: ICICI Securities's research report on RateGain Travel Technologies

Q2FY27 revenue fell 5% QoQ, but management attributed the dip to two identifiable factors: a USD 2.5mn FIFA World Cup one-off in Q1 and the usual 5–10% Q1-to-Q2 seasonality in DMO spend. Organic growth was 14% YoY in Q2 and 15.7% in H1, above the 12–15% guided range. Properties and Destinations each grew over 20% organically; the drag is Sojern’s corporate business (c.16% of MarTech), down ~14% organically in H1. FY27 guidance was reaffirmed – revenue at the upper end of INR 30–31bn and adj. EBITDA margin of 22.5–23.5%, with H1 at 23.7%. We are building in revenue/EBITDA/PAT CAGRs of 39%/48%/53%.

Maintain BUY with a TP to INR 1,150 (earlier INR 1,350), as we cut our target multiple to 30x (from 35x) FY28E EPS, given limited visibility on normalcy in Middle East and recovery in the corporate business.
